deformation.method: Independent glTF accessor decoder, sampler and CPU linear blend skinning. All delivered key times plus uniform 30 Hz; every body, every clip, soccer and all garment morph extremes. Joint metrics use vertices blending the two adjoining elbow/knee bones and triangle edges touching those vertices.
deformation.limits: Finite vertices, unit weights, canonical bind and topology are hard checks. Determinant and edge-stretch values are measurements rather than a universal perceptual threshold. Garment collapse targets may contain hidden triangles. Inspect the corresponding rendered eight-frame sheets for folds, intersections and joint appearance. This does not certify a physical-device frame rate.
